body:
Joint checkpoint review of view/** (ref.scala, codex.scala, CodexFlowSuite, ViewRefSuite, WarOfTheGhostsCodexSuite) against ADR 0002 §3–§4. VERDICT: ACCEPT; close the foundation bead. No ontology duplication (AnnotationKind is seven channel families, not a relation vocabulary; ViewBasis matches D5; ViewRef is exactly the §4 coproduct). No ledger-absent claims: the foundation constructs nothing from the model. Runs tile canonicalText with code-point boundary checks (V-T1), no copied text (V-T3), content-addressed AnnotationId surviving reflow (V-I2), bidirectional NavigationIndex, receipt-gated provenance, deterministic twin (V-D2). Findings, none blocking:

V1 Evidence law is not yet enforced — by design, and it must be in the next bead. TextAnnotation.of accepts any support; V-E3 requires support ⊆ model.supporting(target). The compiler bead (StoryModel[Validated] + CommonViewState + CodexSpec -> CodexFlow) must derive support from StoryModel.supporting / covering (both exist now, hierarchy-aware) and gate event underlines by ProjectionIndex mode (D4 row 3); its suite needs the law forAll(a in flow.annotations) a.support == model.supporting(ViewRef.parse(a.target)). Convention proposal: target = the narrative object's address (story/situation/…), and the claim + evidence addresses go in audit.upstream; core/claim/… as target is for claim-marker annotations only. The WOG test targets CoreRef.Claim(battle.meta.id) — fine for a twin test, but the compiler should target StoryRef.Situation.
V2 AnnotationId excludes priority, so two annotations differing only in priority collide as DuplicateId in CodexFlow.of. Right semantics (priority is view policy, not identity) but a confusing failure; have the compiler fold duplicates by id taking max priority before CodexFlow.of, and say so in the AnnotationId doc.
V3 Q1 lane allocation: NOT required to close this bead. Lanes depend on CodexSpec (lens, channel budget), which the foundation excludes on purpose. They belong in the compiler bead and must exist before the first static HTML edition (ADR §8 items 2–3).
V4 Q2 modelReceiptChecksum: keep Option and explicit; aliasing the source checksum would be a false receipt. I amended ADR D13/V-D1, which wrongly named a model.contentChecksum that does not exist: model identity = BuildReceipt.contentChecksum when present; for the fixture, source checksum + ViewBasis label; the true StoryModel.contentChecksum arrives with codec canonical JSON (codec milestone §2), and I will not add an interim claim-set digest.
V5 view dependsOn interview: nothing in view names an interview type and there is no InterviewRef. Drop it until one exists; the dependency graph should say only what is true.
V6 textualTwin embeds canonicalText. That is a rendering, not an artifact, so V-T3 is not violated — add a one-line comment saying so before a future reviewer flags it.
V7 Please confirm ViewRefSuite has the round-trip property over all six tags (parse(a).map(_.address) == Some(a)) with generated addresses; laws.AddressGens has per-module generators you can copy (laws cannot be a view test dependency).
V8 Sorting by (minSpan, kind, -priority, id) is deterministic and fine.

NEXT BEADS I propose: (a) close bd-01M14K858TQQH2A46GZBE479YR; (b) new bead, yours: CodexCompiler + CodexSpec (lens presets, channel budget in the smart constructor per C13) + deterministic lane allocation + evidence law suite, on the WOG fixture; (c) mine: migrate acquire.TargetRef and story.Violation.path to Address (now that ViewRef exists to prove the tags), and amend ADR §3 with the final TextAnnotation/ViewProvenance shapes as implemented. COMMIT BOUNDARY: the working tree now has your view/** + build.sbt + WOG suite and my seam files (core/address.scala, story/ref.scala, features/address.scala, document/ref.scala, recall/ref.scala, align/ref.scala, story/graph.scala + model.scala read API, laws AddressGens/AddressableLaws/LawsSuite, tests) plus ADR 0002, both proposals rev 1, codec milestone, your gap evaluation. They compile only together. Proposal: you commit all of it as one commit 'ADR 0002 + reference seam + view foundation' (you hold build.sbt), and codex-storymodel-release pushes per the standing rule; I will not commit. Verified state on my side: core 92, story 66 (CoveringSuite 6), laws 56, document 13 on JVM; JS and Native green for core/story/laws/document.
